title: Per-token SLI rollout, region-aware failover panels, and automated load-shedding alerts
creator: Mateo Rivera
description:
Objective: Instrument and ship a set of per-token SLIs and new Grafana panels that combine region-aware failover views, circuit-breaker state, and load-shedding metrics. The goal is to make token-level latency and service degradation visible, enable automatic low-priority request shedding, and provide on-call with clear runbooks to restore SLOs during multi-region incidents.

Scope:
- Define and compute per-token percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for request generation time normalized to token boundary.
- Export a token-rate-normalized SLI that can be aggregated by model, region, and customer tier.
- Add Grafana panels that show: active failover routes (by region), circuit-breaker state per serving-pool, shed/blocked request counts, and SLO burn rates correlated with load-shedding events.
- Wire alerts for burn-rate, circuit-breaker flips, and sustained shedding with clear paging/resolution instructions.
- Implement automated low-priority request load-shedding (policy + metrics) behind a feature flag; integrate metrics with dashboards and CI load tests.

Success criteria (high level):
- Per-token SLIs are emitted for 95% of production requests and visible in dashboards.
- Alerts fire with <2 min delay when p95 token latency crosses configured SLO thresholds or when circuit breakers flip.
- Automated load-shedding reduces token-rate by at least 30% under overload scenarios while preserving high-priority request success rate >= 99% in canary tests.
- On-call runbook validated and used in one simulated failover game day with >80% checklist completion.

Measurement approach:
- Instrument the inference runtime to emit "token_latency_ms" with token index and request priority tags. Use a rolling histogram (t-digest) at the edge to compute p50/p95/p99 per-minute.
- Compute SLI as the fraction of tokens that complete below threshold per minute (configurable per model and tier).
- Correlate SLI with circuit-breaker state and request-shed counters in Grafana using a unified request_id tag for traces.

Rollout plan:
1) Internal opt-in: enable token-level metrics for 10% of traffic by model for 48h (feature flag).
2) Canary: enable load-shedding logic behind flag for specific tenant groups and run synthetic overload tests.
3) Gradual increase to all production traffic and enable alerts.
4) Post-rollout review and tuning (2-week burn window).

Risks & mitigations:
- Overhead of token instrumentation may add CPU/allocs: mitigated by sampling + edge histogram aggregation.
- False positives from short-lived spikes: use burn-rate windows and hysteresis on circuit-breaker alerts.
- Incorrect shedding policy could impact paid customers: default to conservative shedding (only non-critical request classes) and require PM approval for tenant-scoped policies.

Deliverables:
- Runtime changes: token_latency_ms emission, per-request priority tag, request_id propagation.
- Backend: t-digest aggregation job + new metrics exported to Prometheus.
- Dashboards: Grafana folder "Reliability / Token SLIs & Failover" with region failover map, circuit-breaker heatmap, shedding histogram, and SLO burn-rate timeline.
- Alerts: Grafana/Alertmanager rules and PagerDuty escalation mapping.
- Runbook: step-by-step recovery and rollback procedures linked below.
acceptance_criteria: All per-token metrics are present for sampled traffic and visible in staging dashboard
Alert rules fire for simulated SLO burns and circuit-breaker flips during game day
Automated shedding activated in canary reduces token throughput by >=30% in synthetic overload tests
Runbook walkthrough completed with SRE and PM sign-off
comments: 2025-11-02 - Triage: Ticket created after postmortem from 2025-10-29 incident flagged lack of token-level visibility during cross-region failover. Assigned to Ava for implementation planning. - Mateo R.

2025-11-09 - Staging validation: synthetic long-seq workload caused circuit-breaker flips in pool-us-west. Observed shedding reduced token-rate 34% and p95 improved by 22%. Documented in dashboard notes. Need to tune breaker thresholds to avoid oscillation. - QA team.

2025-11-11 - PM notes: Add tenant opt-out flag for shedding and require legal approval for any tenant-targeted shedding. Also requested a Grafana link with drilldowns for top 10 tenants affected. - Priya P.
